Firm founded 1986 ("our team brings years of experience")
IP phone and fax lines for each office; single generic email addresses

listing.reviews: none displayed in limited Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: Menu 'Contact Us' link; no phone CTA in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form hosted by a third party (accountantsofficeonline.com) behind a Google reCAPTCHA checkbox; no booking
website_review.trust_signals: Founded 1986, two office addresses with maps, tax-center tools; no reviews, testimonials, credentials or team page
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer reads 'Copyright (c) 2015 MARK A COLLER, CPA'; home title is just 'Home - Mark A Coller'; meta description mixes 'Staten Island Accountant' with 'East Brunswick CPA'; no phone number in the mobile header and no tel: links anywhere on the site
website_review.search_basics: Weak - no page title or description naming the service and town pair; services and resources have their own pages; the home page copy is generic ('design an achievable roadmap to a healthy financial future')
top_issues: Copyright says 2015 and the site reads as a decade-old template
No click-to-call: phone numbers are plain text on desktop and absent from the mobile header
Contact form sits behind a reCAPTCHA checkbox on a third-party domain, so agents cannot submit it
No schema.org markup, no hours published, no pricing
Meta description is Staten-Island-centric and does not mention East Brunswick services

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google listing exists with the East Brunswick address, category 'Certified public accountant', hours ('Opens 9 AM') and site link, but the profile shows no rating or reviews at all; robots.txt was not fetched (inference: no restriction evident). Answerable: services and both addresses are text, but there are no hours, no prices, no schema and the copy never says what they do in the H1. Bookable: only a third-party form with a reCAPTCHA checkbox - the definition of a wall for an AI agent.

operations_signals.signal: Two offices fielded by phone and fax with generic inboxes (Mark@ and Office@ addresses) - manual routing
Third-party form with reCAPTCHA suggests spam problems and no CRM behind the form

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the front end: current copyright, real page titles/descriptions for 'CPA East Brunswick', click-to-call in the mobile header, hours and LocalBusiness schema
top_opportunities.evidence: Footer 'Copyright (c) 2015'; title 'Home - Mark A Coller'; no tel: links found on the home page source

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the CAPTCHA'd third-party form with a labeled, spam-filtered form plus online consultation booking
top_opportunities.evidence: Form posts to accountantsofficeonline.com with g-recaptcha-response field

top_opportunities.opportunity: Review-generation and client-reminder agent (two offices, zero visible reviews despite 40 years in business)
top_opportunities.evidence: Google listing displays no rating; site has no testimonials

scores.reasons: Ten-year-old site with no click-to-call, no schema, CAPTCHA'd form and no reviews, so a lot is missing; a two-office practice from 1986 has some means but the presentation suggests little marketing spend; fixes are straightforward; I rendered the site at desktop and phone width and read the contact page source.

businesses.name: Neppalli Financial Services
businesses.what_they_do: Accounting and tax advisory practice serving high-income individuals and business owners: tax planning and preparation for individuals and businesses, IRS compliance and representation, accounting/bookkeeping, and consulting/advisory including FP&A build-out and financial modelling.
businesses.customers: High-income earners, business owners and companies wanting advisory/FP&A support in central New Jersey

size_signals.signal: Single firm with one East Brunswick address (though the contact page lists two different suites)
Standard CPA Site Solutions template with four service pages and no team page

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited Maps view

website_review.phone_layout: usable (not verified - the site's hosting returned 403 to my browser, so the mobile render could not be checked)
website_review.primary_cta: Contact page form plus phone; no hero call to action on the home page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form only; there is no booking page (book-appointment.php returns 404)
website_review.trust_signals: Very thin - no testimonials, no team, no credentials, no photos of real work
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Two different addresses on the same contact page (28 Kennedy Blvd Suite 150 and 197 State Route 18 Suite 305); robots.txt sitemap line and template-era styling; home page has no address, hours or phone above the fold
website_review.search_basics: Titles are template-generated but location-aware ('East Brunswick, NJ Accounting Firm | Contact Page'); the home page however has no address, hours or phone and only generic service blurbs
top_issues: Contact page displays two conflicting office addresses
No hours anywhere on the site, and the Google profile has no hours either ('Add hours')
No testimonials, credentials or team information - nothing to build trust
No online booking and no appointment page
Home page does not say who they serve or include contact details

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google Business Profile shows 5.0, category 'Accounting firm', the Route 18 address and phone, and links both the website and zohobookings.com - but hours are missing ('Add hours') and the address contradicts the site. Answerable: services appear as readable blurbs, but there are no hours, no prices and no schema; the address is ambiguous, which is the worst case for an AI answering 'where are they and when are they open'. Bookable: no booking page exists on the site; the profile links a Zoho Bookings domain, so agents may find a scheduler through Google rather than the site (inference from the profile link).

operations_signals.signal: Google profile links a Zoho Bookings domain, so some appointment scheduling already runs on an online tool outside the website (inference from the link)
Advisory work (FP&A build-out, financial modelling) is sold alongside compliance - two very different intake processes with no visible forms

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the address conflict, publish hours and a service-area statement as text, and add LocalBusiness schema
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page lists both 28 Kennedy Blvd Suite 150 and 197 State Route 18 Suite 305; site has no hours; GBP says 'Add hours'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put the Zoho booking flow and a qualified intake form directly on the site so prospects do not have to leave for Google
top_opportunities.evidence: Profile links zohobookings.com while the site has no booking page (book-appointment.php is 404)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Trust and content build-out: testimonials, credentials, advisory case examples, individual service pages with FAQ text
top_opportunities.evidence: Site has no testimonials, no team, no credentials and only four generic service blurbs

scores.reasons: Conflicting addresses, no hours, no booking on site and no trust content is a lot missing, but the firm already has a 5.0 rating and a Zoho account, so the fix is assembly rather than invention; a template-based single office implies modest budget; my evidence is limited because the site 403'd my browser and I relied on fetched page text and the Google listing.

caveats: Four sites in this batch (Versutus, Evan Butchen, Neppalli and - separately - Barry Safeer) refused or failed a normal browser session; Versutus/Butchen/Neppalli run on the same CPA Site Solutions hosting, which returned HTTP 403 to my Chrome, so their phone-width layouts are inferred from responsive template markup rather than seen.
Google Maps served a 'limited view' to my browser in every case, so star ratings were readable but review counts were not. Ratings shown are as displayed at the time of the search (2026-11-12).

Review-based operations signals were not available for this batch - none of these firms publish many reviews and none had consumer complaints I could read; operations findings therefore rest on site structure and stated offers.

Inferences are labelled inline. Notably: Gary Mehta's East Brunswick listing vs Jersey City office, and Neppalli's use of Zoho Bookings, are inferences from listing links and schema, not statements by the firms.
data_gaps: Review counts for all 10 Google listings (limited Maps view).
Barry J. Safeer's practice details: the site returns Cloudflare 525 so no services, hours, email or staff could be verified; directory snippets were not treated as firm statements.
robots.txt was not fetched for fourbrothersfinancial.com (GoDaddy builder) or collercpa.com; AI-bot access there is unverified.
Phone-width screenshots were captured only for PNF and Mark Coller; the other sites either blocked the browser or were assessed from source markup.
Matthews & Nulty and Gary Mehta phone numbers differ between batch/directory records and the firms' own pages; not resolvable without contacting the businesses, which is out of scope.
